A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (18 March 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:CC-L-kebyc-PC-Errata-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Kebyc]]: The game text changes: “related” is added after “Force drains at”; “sectors on same planet,” becomes “sectors,”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels with the corrected text and the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The whole printed card image and the whole 2024 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
